bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 盘中新低 $42.65，收盘守住 $45

read.en: AAOI rose 0.1% on Nov 17 to $45.22, trading $42.65–48.13. It is below the 5-day ($49.8), 10-day ($50.6), 30-day ($72.1), 100-day ($101.2) and 200-day ($115.0); all but the 200-day are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 16 ($57.68), and RSI is 32.1.
read.zh: AAOI 11月17日上涨 0.1%，收于 $45.22，盘中区间 $42.65–48.13。股价位于 5 日（$49.8）、10 日（$50.6）、30 日（$72.1）、100 日（$101.2）和 200 日均线（$115.0）下方，除 200 日外均在下行。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月16日起看空（$57.68），RSI 为 32.1。

read.en: The $42.65 low undercut the $44.8–45.2 support (Nov 16 and Nov 6 lows), but the close recovered above it, so it still holds. Resistance is $47.3–48.1 (Nov 13 low, Nov 16 and 17 highs), then $49.8–50.8 (5 and 10-day, Nov 12 low) and $52.9–53.5. Support is $44.8–45.2, then $42.65 (Nov 17 low) and $40–41.4. A close above $48.1 would target $50–50.8; below $44.8, $42.65.
